+import pytest
+
+from slugtools import slugify
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ('text', 'expected'),
+    [
+        ('Hello, World!', 'hello-world'),
+        ('  --Already__Spaced--  ', 'already-spaced'),
+        ('ABC 123 xyz', 'abc-123-xyz'),
+        ('a---b', 'a-b'),
+        ('Café au lait', 'caf-au-lait'),
+        ('Kelvin', 'elvin'),
+        ('İstanbul', 'stanbul'),
+        ('', ''),
+        (' -_!? ', ''),
+    ],
+)
+def test_slugify(text, expected):
+    assert slugify(text) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('value', [None, 42, b'bytes', ['a']])
+def test_slugify_rejects_non_strings(value):
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        slugify(value)

+import pytest
+
+from slugtools import slugify
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("text", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("  Hello, WORLD__42!  ", "hello-world-42"),
+        ("AéB", "a-b"),
+        ("", ""),
+        ("...___   ", ""),
+    ],
+)
+def test_slugify_normalizes_ascii_text(text, expected):
+    assert slugify(text) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [None, 42, b"hello"])
+def test_slugify_rejects_non_strings(value):
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        slugify(value)
